_doc: Every tunable assumption in one place. The map, trip planner, demand model and reports all read this file, so they can never drift apart again.

wait._doc: Expected wait = headway / 2, capped (riders time arrivals on long headways).

access._doc: How people reach stations. Walk to anything within walk_max_m; drive (park & ride) to commuter rail stations and line termini within pnr_max_km.

competitive._doc: A commute is transit-competitive if transit <= ratio*drive + slack, under the cap, and longer than min_km.

demand._doc: If data/raw/od_tracts.csv (LODES OD aggregated to tracts, see data/README.md) exists it is used directly. Otherwise a doubly-constrained gravity model is synthesized from tract population and jobs, with beta calibrated against the v1 LODES run.

cost_musd_per_km._doc: Capital cost per route-km by mode and grade, 2025 USD. Calibrated to recent US projects: DART Silver Line ~$45M/km (new track on freight ROW), TEXRail ~$24M/km, Houston/Indy BRT $5-25M/km, US light rail $100-200M/km, US subway $400M+/km.

standards._doc: Stop-spacing bands (km) used by validate. Sources in reports/DESIGN_STANDARDS.md.

cores._doc: Downtown cores: proposed metro inside these radii is costed as tunnel.
